facts.text: Tim has never been part of a sports team.

evidence.quote: We were teammates for four years in high school, so we've played together for quite some time. Have you ever been part of a sports team?
Nope, never been on a sports team.

facts.text: Tim enjoys reading fantasy novels and traveling to experience different magical worlds.

evidence.quote: I'm more into reading and fantasy novels. I love sinking into different magical worlds. It's one of the reasons I love traveling to new places, to experience a different kind of magic.

facts.text: John has visited New York City and shared a photo of the city skyline.

evidence.quote: By the way, I love discovering new cities - check out this pic from one of my trips to New York City! [image: a photo of a cityscape with a view of a skyscraper]

facts.text: John enjoys exploring new cities and trying different restaurants.

evidence.quote: Exploring the city and trying all the restaurants was awesome. It's a must-visit.
